reasons.action: The caller explicitly asks the man at the counter to speak again, repeating the recorded line word for word; that requested vocal performance is the action and it outranks any static pose, and no visual reference exists to compete with it.
reasons.medium: No supplied reference has authority over the rendering medium, and the pinned medium decision already leaves rendering permission as no_reference, so the medium is request-governed with no rendering style attached.
reasons.wardrobe: The only supplied asset is an audio clip that carries voice timbre and delivery, not appearance; with no visual reference, no observed clothing is available to retain, so wardrobe rests on the request, which names none and therefore leaves it unfixed rather than borrowed.
reasons.lighting: The audio reference describes only a flat close-mic voice and supplies no illumination information; there is no visual reference whose light could be carried over, so lighting remains request-governed and unspecified.
reasons.framing: The request describes behavior at a counter rather than a camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement, and the audio reference has no frame; with no visual reference, framing stays request-governed and unstated.
reasons.palette: Nothing in the request or the audio reference addresses color, tonal grading, saturation or contrast, and no visual reference exists to inherit a grade from, so palette remains request-governed and unspecified.
